exercises.instruction: Напишите предложения с might. Напишите предложения с might not.

items.prompt: (it’s possible that I’ll go to the cinema)
answers: I might go to the cinema.

items.prompt: (it’s possible that I’ll see you tomorrow)
answers: I might see you tomorrow.

items.prompt: (it’s possible that Sarah will forget to phone)
answers: Sarah might forget to phone.

items.prompt: (it’s possible that it will snow today)
answers: It might snow today.

items.prompt: (it’s possible that I’ll be late tonight)
answers: I might be late tonight.

items.prompt: (it’s possible that Mark will not be here next week)
answers: Mark might not be here next week.

items.prompt: (it’s possible that I won’t have time to go out)
answers: I might not have time to go out.

exercises.instruction: Вас спрашивают о планах. У вас есть некоторые идеи, но вы не уверены. Выберите слова из рамки и напишите предложения с I might.

parts: Where are you going for your holidays? I’m not sure.
answers: I might go to Italy.

parts: What are you doing at the weekend? I don’t know. I
answers: might go away.

parts: When will you see Kate again? I’m not sure.
answers: I might see her on Monday.

parts: What are you going to have for dinner? I don’t know.
answers: I might have fish.

parts: How are you going to get home tonight? I’m not sure.
answers: I might get a taxi.
I might take a taxi.
I might go by taxi.

parts: I hear you won some money. What are you going to do with it? I haven’t decided yet.
answers: I might buy a new car.
I might get a new car.

exercises.instruction: Вы задали Бену вопросы о его планах на завтра. В некоторых планах он уверен, но в большинстве случаев он сомневается. Теперь напишите, что Бен будет делать завтра. Где необходимо, также используйте might.

items.prompt: Are you playing tennis tomorrow? — Yes, in the afternoon.
answers: He’s playing tennis tomorrow afternoon.

items.prompt: Are you going out tomorrow evening? — Possibly.
answers: He might go out tomorrow evening.

items.prompt: Are you going to get up early? — Perhaps.
answers: He might get up early.

items.prompt: Are you working tomorrow? — No, I’m not.
answers: He isn’t working tomorrow.
He’s not working tomorrow.

items.prompt: Will you be at home tomorrow morning? — Maybe.
answers: He might be at home tomorrow morning.

items.prompt: Are you going to watch TV? — I might.
answers: He might watch TV.

items.prompt: Are you going out in the afternoon? — Yes, I am.
answers: He’s going out in the afternoon.

items.prompt: Are you going shopping? — Perhaps.
answers: He might go shopping.

exercises.instruction: Напишите три предложения о том, что вы, возможно, будете делать завтра. Используйте might.

modelAnswers: I might buy some new clothes.
I might go out with some friends.
I might have an egg for breakfast.

exercises.instruction: Переведите предложения на английский язык, используя might или may. (спортзал = gym, на Новый год = at New Year)

items.prompt: Возможно, завтра мы тебя увидим.
answers: We might see you tomorrow.
We may see you tomorrow.

items.prompt: Марина больна. Может быть, она останется дома.
answers: Marina is ill. She might stay at home.
Marina is ill. She may stay at home.

items.prompt: А: Вы идёте на вечеринку? В: Возможно, я пойду.
answers: A: Are you going to the party? B: I might go.
A: Are you going to the party? B: I may go.
A: Are you going to the party? B: I might.
A: Are you going to the party? B: I may.

items.prompt: Я устал. Возможно, я не пойду в спортзал.
answers: I’m tired. I might not go to the gym.
I’m tired. I may not go to the gym.
I am tired. I might not go to the gym.
I am tired. I may not go to the gym.

items.prompt: Я могу Вам помочь?
answers: May I help you?
Can I help you?

items.prompt: В субботу, возможно, пойдёт снег.
answers: It might snow on Saturday.
It may snow on Saturday.

items.prompt: Возможно, я поеду в Финляндию на Новый год.
answers: I might go to Finland at New Year.
I may go to Finland at New Year.

items.prompt: Может быть, завтра меня не будет на работе.
answers: I might not be at work tomorrow.
I may not be at work tomorrow.
